result.summary: 本文训练了 1750 亿参数的自回归语言模型 GPT-3，并在不进行任何梯度更新或微调的情况下，用零样本、单样本和少样本设置评估其性能 [abstract][S1.p9]。GPT-3 在翻译、问答、完形填空以及需要即时推理或领域适应的任务上取得较强表现，少样本设置有时可与或偶尔超过此前最优的微调方法 [abstract][S1.p11]。同时，论文也指出 GPT-3 在部分数据集上仍然表现不佳，并存在与大规模网络语料训练相关的方法论问题 [abstract][S1.p13]。作者还发现 GPT-3 生成的新闻文章样本让人类评估者难以与人类撰写的文章区分，并讨论了其更广泛的社会影响 [abstract][S1.p12]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：现有预训练加微调范式虽然架构任务无关，但仍需要每个任务数千到数十万个特定任务的标注样本进行微调 [S1.p2]。作者指出，人类通常只需少量示例或简单指令就能完成新的语言任务，而当前 NLP 系统在这方面仍存在困难 [abstract][S1.p5]。因此，论文测试扩大语言模型规模是否能大幅提升任务无关的少样本性能 [abstract][S1.p9]。

evidence.quote: there is still a need for task-specific datasets and task-specific fine-tuning: to achieve strong performance on a desired task typically requires fine-tuning on a dataset of thousands to hundreds of thousands of examples specific to that task.
humans do not require large supervised datasets to learn most language tasks
Here we show that scaling up language models greatly improves task-agnostic, few-shot performance
In this paper, we test this hypothesis by training a 175 billion parameter autoregressive language model, which we call GPT-3, and measuring its in-context learning abilities.

method.text: 论文训练了 8 个不同规模的模型，参数从 1.25 亿到 1750 亿，其中最大模型称为 GPT-3 [S2.SS1.p1]。GPT-3 沿用 GPT-2 的模型和架构，但在 transformer 层中使用交替的稠密和局部带状稀疏注意力模式 [S2.SS1.p1]。评估时，GPT-3 不进行任何梯度更新或微调，任务和少样本示例完全通过文本交互指定 [abstract]。论文在零样本、单样本和少样本三种设置下评估，少样本通常使用 10 到 100 个示例 [S1.p9][S2.p2]。

evidence.quote: we train 8 different sizes of model, ranging over three orders of magnitude from 125 million parameters to 175 billion parameters, with the last being the model we call GPT-3.

We use the same model and architecture as GPT-2, including the modified initialization, pre-normalization, and reversible tokenization described therein, with the exception that we use alternating dense and locally banded sparse attention patterns in the layers of the transformer
For all tasks, GPT-3 is applied without any gradient updates or fine-tuning, with tasks and few-shot demonstrations specified purely via text interaction with the model.

we evaluate GPT-3 under 3 conditions: (a) “few-shot learning”, or in-context learning where we allow as many demonstrations as will fit into the model’s context window (typically 10 to 100), (b) “one-shot learning”, where we allow only one demonstration, and (c) “zero-shot” learning, where no demonstrations are allowed and only an instruction in natural language is given to the model.
We typically set $K$ in the range of 10 to 100 as this is how many examples can fit in the model’s context window

experiments.text: 论文在超过两打 NLP 数据集以及若干为测试快速适应而设计的新任务上评估 GPT-3 [S1.p9]。评估覆盖语言建模、闭卷问答、翻译、Winograd 风格任务、常识推理、阅读理解、SuperGLUE、NLI 以及合成任务等类别 [S3.p3]。此外，论文还系统研究了数据污染问题，构建了清理后的基准子集来量化其影响 [S1.p15][S4.p5]。

evidence.quote: we evaluate GPT-3 on over two dozen NLP datasets, as well as several novel tasks designed to test rapid adaptation to tasks unlikely to be directly contained in the training set.
In Section 3.1 we evaluate on traditional language modeling tasks and tasks that are similar to language modeling, such as Cloze tasks and sentence/paragraph completion tasks.
We also undertake a systematic study of “data contamination”
For each benchmark, we produce a ‘clean’ version which removes all potentially leaked examples

findings.text: GPT-3 在零样本和单样本设置下取得有希望的结果，少样本设置有时可与或偶尔超过此前最优的微调模型 [S1.p11]。例如在 CoQA 上，GPT-3 零样本达到 81.5 F1，单样本 84.0 F1，少样本 85.0 F1 [S1.p11]；在 TriviaQA 上，零样本 64.3%，单样本 68.0%，少样本 71.2%，后者在相同闭卷设置下相对微调模型达到最优 [S1.p11]。GPT-3 还在需要即时推理或快速适应的任务上表现出单样本和少样本能力，并能生成让人类评估者难以与人类文章区分的合成新闻文章 [S1.p12]。同时，论文发现少样本性能在部分任务上仍然困难，包括 ANLI 等自然语言推理任务以及 RACE、QuAC 等阅读理解数据集 [S1.p13]。

evidence.quote: in the the few-shot setting is sometimes competitive with or even occasionally surpasses state-of-the-art (despite state-of-the-art being held by fine-tuned models).
GPT-3 achieves 81.5 F1 on CoQA in the zero-shot setting, 84.0 F1 on CoQA in the one-shot setting, 85.0 F1 in the few-shot setting.

GPT-3 achieves 64.3% accuracy on TriviaQA in the zero-shot setting, 68.0% in the one-shot setting, and 71.2% in the few-shot setting, the last of which is state-of-the-art relative to fine-tuned models operating in the same closed-book setting.
GPT-3 also displays one-shot and few-shot proficiency at tasks designed to test rapid adaption or on-the-fly reasoning
GPT-3 can generate synthetic news articles which human evaluators have difficulty distinguishing from human-generated articles.

we also find some tasks on which few-shot performance struggles, even at the scale of GPT-3. This includes natural language inference tasks like the ANLI dataset, and some reading comprehension datasets like RACE or QuAC.

limitations.text: 作者承认 GPT-3 在文本合成和若干 NLP 任务上仍有明显弱点，例如在文档级别语义重复、长段落失去连贯性、自相矛盾，以及偶尔出现不合逻辑的句子或段落 [S5.p2]。GPT-3 在“常识物理”问题上似乎特别困难，并且在部分“比较”任务（如 WiC 和 ANLI）以及部分阅读理解任务上，单样本甚至少样本表现仅略好于随机 [S5.p2]。作者还指出，论文只使用自回归语言模型，未包含双向架构或其他训练目标，这可能以牺牲部分任务性能为代价 [S5.p3]。此外，预训练样本效率差、少样本学习究竟是从头学习还是识别已见任务存在不确定性，以及大模型推理昂贵且不便，都是作者明确承认的局限 [S5.p5][S5.p6][S5.p7]。

evidence.quote: GPT-3 samples still sometimes repeat themselves semantically at the document level, start to lose coherence over sufficiently long passages, contradict themselves, and occasionally contain non-sequitur sentences or paragraphs.
GPT-3 seems to have special difficulty with “common sense physics”

it does little better than chance when evaluated one-shot or even few-shot on some “comparison” tasks, such as determining if two words are used the same way in a sentence, or if one sentence implies another (WIC and ANLI respectively), as well as on a subset of reading comprehension tasks.
our experiments do not include any bidirectional architectures or other training objectives such as denoising.
Another limitation broadly shared by language models is poor sample efficiency during pre-training.
ambiguity about whether few-shot learning actually learns new tasks “from scratch” at inference time, or if it simply recognizes and identifies tasks that it has learned during training.
they are both expensive and inconvenient to perform inference on, which may present a challenge for practical applicability of models of this scale in their current form.
